defaultObjective: Start alone on the Paris road. Defeat the scout, then find the voice waiting beyond the boulevard.

regions.name: Rue Cendre
regions.objective: Paris is quiet. Verso starts alone; follow the road east and survive the first scout.

regions.name: Meadow Wake
regions.objective: The first campfire is alive. Defeat the road scout, then follow the boulevard toward Maelle's signal.

regions.name: Silent Market
regions.objective: The market is empty, but the road still points east. Push through the ruins.

regions.name: Western Watch
regions.objective: A side path leads to an old watch post. Claim the campfire before returning to the main road.

regions.name: Pilgrim Crossing
regions.objective: The road splits around an enemy patrol. Win the crossing and the mirror gate will come into view.

regions.name: Glass Shrine
regions.objective: The shrine campfire offers one last recovery. Gather strength before the eastern road.

regions.name: Mirror Gate
regions.objective: The clone waits beyond the gate. Defeat it to prove Verso is more than an echo.
